title: The Race & Objects Around Us
subject: English Language
objectives: Listen to and retell a short story
Understand the lesson of the story

blocks.alt: A dog and a tortoise at the finish line of a race
blocks.caption: The tortoise wins the race!

blocks.md:
Long ago, **Tortoise** challenged **Dog** to a race.

*'I can run faster than you,'* said Tortoise.

*'You? You must be joking!'* laughed Dog.

But Tortoise had a plan. He placed pieces of **delicious meat** along the path. Dog loved meat!

When the race started, Dog ran very fast. But then he smelled the meat. He stopped to eat. He ate one piece, then another, and another.

By the time Dog reached the finish line, Tortoise was already there — **waiting and smiling**.

All the animals clapped for Tortoise.
**The lesson:** Do not be greedy. Being slow and steady can win against being fast and careless.

Here are some common objects you will find in a home. Say each one aloud:

- A **plate** (you eat from it)
- A **spoon** (you use it to eat)
- A **pot** (you cook in it)
- A **mat** (you sit on it)
- A **bed** (you sleep on it)
- A **pillow** (you rest your head on it)
- A **table** (you eat or write on it)
- A **door** (you walk through it)

quiz.q: Why did Dog stop during the race?
quiz.explain: Dog stopped to eat the delicious meat Tortoise left on the path.
The tortoise won because the dog was distracted by the meat.

quiz.q: What is the lesson of the story?
options: Do not be greedy; slow and steady can win
quiz.explain: The story teaches us that greed can make us lose, and slow and steady can win.

quiz.q: Which of these do you sleep on?
Which of these do you eat from?
quiz.explain: You eat food from a plate.
